rswjeb34.variantName: Christmas Tree World 7ft Pre-Lit Ultra Mountain Pine With Bag Christmas Tree
rswjeb34.sourceDescription: Our MD's favourite! With a classic upturned shape and incorporating super lifelike PE plastic moulded branch tips, we love the final look of this 7ft pre-lit Christmas tree. The Pre-Lit Ultra Mountain Pine's curved outer branches not only provide an eye-catching silhouette but they also create plenty of space to hang pretty Christmas tree decorations. Our customers love how full and bushy the Pre-Lit Ultra Mountain Pine looks year after year. It is also one of our easiest 7ft Christmas trees to erect. That's thanks to the hinged and contoured branches that effortlessly fall into place (you just need to tweak the inner branches a little to fill the gaps) and the ready-lit branches. Picture shows 7ft tree in our range. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom

j2wry0j7.sourceDescription: This Realistic Pre-Lit Dellonda 5ft Christmas Tree is perfect for a small room so you have more room for presents! Made up of 772 PE/PVC branch tips to give a natural and realistic look and feel. Hinged branches make this Christmas tree easy to assemble and store away. wtg3wzed.baseName: Walplus Faux Fur Patterned Christmas Tree Skirt - White - 90 cm
wtg3wzed.variantName: Walplus Faux Fur Patterned Christmas Tree Skirt - White - 90 cm
wtg3wzed.sourceDescription: This luxury Christmas tree skirt helps hide your bare Christmas tree stand. So you can put ornaments and presents on it for decoration. This Christmas tree base featuring a non-woven fabric on the back and thick faux fur on the front is smooth and comfortable, adding a warm touch to your house. The snowflake sequin embroidery on it brings a vivid winter atmosphere. The tree skirt sits elegantly at the base of your Christmas tree, making it the perfect spot for placing and unboxing presents. This tree decoration also has long-lasting durability, so you can use it as a home carpet or store it for next year. Product Specifications Colour: White Material: 300 gsm faux fur Diameter: 90 cm Middle hole diameter: 10 cm With non-woven backing Features embroidered snowflakes This christmas tree skirt is designed solely for domestic holiday decoration and floor protection. To prevent severe fire hazards or property damage, never allow the fabric to come into direct contact with open flames, hot candles, or exposed electrical wiring from holiday lights. Inspect all tree light strands for frayed cords before placing them near the skirt. Ensure the skirt is laid completely flat around the base of the tree stand to avoid creating a dangerous tripping hazard for residents or guests. Do not block access to water reservoirs on live trees. This seasonal textile product is not a toy; keep all decorative ties, metallic trim, small sequins, and plastic packaging completely out of the reach of infants, small children, and pets. Manufacturer Name: WALPLUS Address: Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingdom Contact: customer.service@walplus.com
